Detailed Description

A UnaryOpUGen usually created using the function exp() when applied to other UGen instances.

It is not normally required to use this UGen explicitly. 

 UGen resultExp  = SinOsc::AR(100, 0, 0.4).exp (); // creates a UnaryExpUGen

You can also use a global version of this function, the above code would be equivalent as: 

 UGen resultExp  =  exp(SinOsc::AR(100, 0, 0.4)); // creates a UnaryExpUGen
See also:
